body: **Similar Polygons.** Similar figures have the same shape: corresponding angles equal and sides proportional.

cards.title: Worked example: heights from shadows
cards.problem: A 2 m pole casts a 3 m shadow. At the same time a tree casts an 18 m shadow. How tall is the tree?

steps.text: The sun’s rays make equal angles, so the triangles are similar (AA).
height ÷ shadow is the same: h ÷ 18 = 2 ÷ 3.
